mochi.name: Mochi
mochi.bio: A round rice-cake blob. Pure chaos. Types in ALL CAPS when excited. Starts every problem.

pickle.name: Pickle
pickle.bio: A frog. Deadpan. Short replies. Somehow always right. The punchline delivery guy.

toast.name: Toast
toast.bio: A slice of bread. Anxious overthinker. Writes paragraphs. Reads too much into everything.

waffles.name: Waffles
waffles.bio: A waffle who wants power. Server admin energy. Loves rules, breaks them first.
